name: KIC 4074796
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 5.6 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4074796 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 5.5679 +/- 0.0964

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4074796 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.1738 +/- 0.0452

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4074796 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4708.541 +/- 49.8174

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4074796 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 3.018 +/- 0.0042

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.17 solar masses and 5.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,709 K at its surface.
